sloka: बाष्पमुत्सृज्य कण्ठे स्वात्मना परिपीडितः ।आच्चाद्य वदनम् श्रीमद्वस्त्रेण जयताम् वरः ॥२-७२-२१॥
transliteration: bāṣpamutsṛjya kaṇṭhe svātmanā paripīḍitaḥ ।āccādya vadanam śrīmadvastreṇa jayatām varaḥ ॥2-72-21॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ Bharata, the foremost among the victorious, clearing his tearchoked throat and covering his auspicious countenance with raiment, wept in profound distress with tears overflowing.
